screens.label: 1. Session target
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity standalone portrait mobile screen for the existing IMPOSTER party game, for design review. Match the attached reference images' actual app design closely; these are style references, not content to copy literally. Use the same slim black Android phone frame, tiny camera hole, front-on view on a very dark charcoal backdrop, equal small outer margins. Phone occupies 95% of image height. Single screen only, no collage, no annotations outside phone. Large crisp readable text, DM Sans-like rounded grotesk, ivory #F4F1E8, dark charcoal #141916 background, muted sage #B4C8AD secondary text, lime #D6F56B primary action and positive score, terracotta #D98672 loss/imposter accent. Bold 32-36px logical headings, 16-18px body, no tiny text. 24px horizontal inset, 16px radius, flat separated lists, initials in round colored avatars. Primary bottom action 60px high, black bold text on lime. Breathing room. Consistent simple custom eye, crown and trophy motifs. Restrained tactile grain only on any small artwork, clean flat app background. No gradients, glass, money, casino chips, bottom tabs, invented navigation, OS status bars, or feature toggles. All bets are GAME POINTS. Do not expose private roles before results. Render exact specified copy and arithmetic.
SCREEN SPECIFICATION:
HOST SESSION SETUP screen. Top back arrow and centered "Session setup". Large heading "Pick a finish line." Below sage "First to the target ends this session." Small flat eye/crown artwork with sage and lime, about 100px tall, no giant decoration. Section "Target score". Five big touch-friendly choices arranged 3 across then 2 across: "10", "15", "20", "25", "30"; 15 selected with lime border and filled check, other choices dark outlined. Under choices "points" in secondary text. Two concise flat informational lines: "Fresh scores every session." and "Optional bets use your own points." Quiet divider then "4 players connected" with four small initials avatars AL SA MI BE. Bottom primary "Start session". No start-round or topic controls. This is a proposed new setup step before existing lobby/start flow.
